draft.title: Aims, hypotheses, models and theories
card: Aim
states what an investigation will find out. It is the purpose, such as to determine how temperature affects the rate of a reaction.
Hypothesis
a testable prediction of the result, often linking two variables. For example, if temperature rises, the reaction rate will increase.
Model
a simplified representation that helps explain or predict how something behaves, such as particles drawn as spheres.
Theory and law
a theory is a well-tested explanation of why something happens. A law describes a pattern in observations, often as a relationship, without explaining why.
draft.remember: Aim: what you will find out. Hypothesis: what you expect to find.

a.q: Which of these is a hypothesis for an investigation into zinc and acid?
opts: If acid concentration increases, the reaction will be faster
To investigate how acid concentration affects reaction rate
Particles are modelled as spheres that collide and react
Mass is neither created nor destroyed in a reaction
a.why: A hypothesis is a testable prediction of a result. The second option states a purpose, so it is an aim. The last two are a model and a law.
a.clue: Which option predicts what will happen?

b.q: Priya says, 'Gases are made of tiny particles that move randomly and collide, which explains why gases fill their containers.' What is this?
opts: A theory, because it explains why gases behave as they do
A law, because it describes a pattern in gas behaviour
A hypothesis, because it predicts a result for a test
An aim, because it states what will be investigated
b.why: The statement gives a well-tested explanation of why gases behave as they do, so it is a theory. A law would describe a pattern, such as a relationship between pressure and volume, without explaining why.
b.clue: Does the statement explain why, or only describe a pattern?

a.best: If acid concentration increases, the reaction will be faster

b.best: A theory, because it explains why gases behave as they do

As shown, the second option is the hypothesis, the third is the aim, the first is the law and the fourth is the model. Name the options by content instead.
